cases.name: Christina "Tina" Czuj
cases.about:
Czuj's family remembered her Sunday as a kindhearted person with a beautiful smile and laugh. She loved animals and rescued two dogs from the side of a highway, nursing them back to health, said stepdaughter Jenni Prochaska. Prochaska said Czuj had married her father, Frank Prochaska, who died in 2018, and was still grieving his loss. She said her stepmother was self-employed as a certified colon hydrotherapist. "She meant everything to me, considering I have lost my biological mother and father," Prochaska said. "So she was my mother and was absolutely great with her granddaughter."
